notes.title: Bruni Multimedia is now Dodonovels
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow players and doctors!

Recently, I was presented with an engaging opportunity that necessitated a shift in my current life. As such, I had to part ways with Bruni Multimedia and pass on the rights of ownership for all games and their licenses to another entity. Although this decision wasn't easy for me to make, it has opened up many doors of potential success moving forward.

Dodonovels is the new entity which will own all of my games in the future.With the idea of rebranding in mind, I believe now is an ideal moment to create a new name and logo for my games.

Updates and patches for all the games have been delayed a lot for this reason, and I apologize for that. With confidence, I will now take the lead again and you can anticipate more releases and content to come shortly. This is even with a few collaborations from some of the people who responded positively to my request for help that I issued only weeks ago.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/32df42671ea1537e9965d1f1001ce7853d3b758d.png[/img]

[b]What is going to change for the games?[/b]
Absolutely nothing, except that bug fixing and new content will be once more made available faster and sooner.

[b]Does this mean you're no longer involved in the projects?[/b]
No, I'm still very much involved. The same development and ideas are still at the wheel and will continue to provide support for each game as usual. Something will change especially in General Practitioner 2, and the game will receive more and more content.

[b]Do you still need our help?[/b]
Of course I do! Crowdfunding and early access is of fundamental importance for very small indie studios like Dodonovels, and the future success and release of the games depends on how well they're received and supported by the public. Without your help , it would be impossible to make all projects a reality.

Thank you for your trust and support during this transition period. It has been an amazing journey so far and I'm looking forward to what the future holds!

Sincerely,

Andrea

notes.title: Looking for patrons, supporters, publishers, friends...
notes.notes:
Dear friends,

I am writing to you today to announce that I am looking for contributors, supporters, publishers and more in order to keep providing the best gaming experience I can. As many of you know, 2022 has been a very tough year globally and sales have decreased dramatically, with the Russian market cut off and the German one taking down 18+ games on Steam.

Deep personal issues over the last two years also took their toll, unfortunately.

That being said, I wish to continue creating the best games possible and to keep supporting the projects I have already created.

Unfortunately, I am a one-man show and cannot work as fast as before due to external influences. Your help would be greatly appreciated in order to reach my goal of delivering the very best gaming experience. It doesn't matter how small your contribution is, every little bit helps in achieving this goal!

I would also like to take this opportunity to thank all of you who are currently supporting me on Patreon. You are the ones that make it possible for me to continue creating the games I love and for that, I can’t thank you enough!

I am open to any type of support, including business relationships and investments. Globally both General Practitioner, GP2 and the other games have had quite a success in the last few years, and GP2 has been praised and well received from the community.

Your support will of course be immensely useful, but [b][u]please note that no game is in danger of being cut down: it might take some more time to release each update, but we're still on the job, and very well focused at it![/u]
[/b]
You can support the game on Patreon or make a special donation/support on paypal.me/brunimultimedia if you prefer.

Thank you for your time and support! I've being doing this job over the last 5 years thanks to you and no one else!

Sincerely,

ANDREA, your game developer.

notes.title: General Practitioner 2 is coming!
notes.notes:
If you're a fan of the original General Practitioner or just looking for an amazing new simulation game to sink your teeth into, then you're going to love what we have in store for you this month. General Practitioner 2[b] is coming to Steam's Early Access on April 2022[/b] and it promises to be even better than the first! 

Early Access will feature three fully featured medical exams, a brand-new relationship system, dozens of HD images, and a complete soundrack. You can also interview and hire your first Nurse, and interact with each of the two brothers separately, choosing every day who you want to play with.

Different brothers also mean different encounters and different medical exams to perform, no day is like any other day in GP2!

GP2 is sure to keep you entertained for hours on end.

Live the life of TWO doctors in this brand-new medical simulated Visual Novel. Andrew and Julie are brothers and MDs and they recently inherited a once-renowned medical clinic from their aunt. Join them in rebuilding the clinic, hiring staff and living their lives.


[b]This time there are two of them![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/18b2eb219677e618126b1a3683eb641010e1d1ba.png[/img]
Choose to live each chapter of the main story from Andrew or Julie's point of view. Different paths mean different stories to unfold, people to meet and consequences to play!

Make them professional, respected doctors or corrupt them down to a path of money, lust or even crime! While a sibling might be a saint, the other one might be the exact opposite! Who knows where you could get them into!



[b]Clinical cases[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/7be8e6b16fc69e4d94951d1a3165dc116acad09e.png[/img]
In the best tradition of the General Practitioner franchise, dozens of clinical cases to explore. Choose the correct way to diagnose an illness with the renewed codex, or do your best to ruin people's lives by giving them a wrong diagnosis. You could also try and get some extra cash by threatening them by exposing some dirty secrets to their family or local police. It's up to you.


[b]Medical accuracy[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/d98f99c11eb5a41a63469f0c3b824b257000054e.png[/img]
Written with deep research and the help of a real MD, General Practitioner 2 focuses on medical accuracy. Every medical information you will find in the game is consistent with the actual medical knowledge. Please remember this is a game, however, and if you need medical help you should always ask your doctor to help you.


[b]New gameplay[/b]

Hire new staff members and manage the hospital in a new story-based gameplay. No more idle days trying to figure out what to do. The game is a full story and even hiring staff and managing stuff (!) is always story-oriented. No chapter will be like another as you get to know pediatricians, midwives, tech gurus, social media marketers and nurses!


[b]Game over IS possible[/b]

Make the wrong choices and the clinic will be shutted off. You will need to balance your bad habits in a way the Medical Board won't open an investigation against you. And if they will... It's up to you to change their mind.


[b]Optional Sexual encounters[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/4d15f93bea00d8f6d7f758b962b47d8d1145c38e.png[/img]
You can try to flirt and romance dozens of characters in the game, including coworkers and patients! But beware, not everything is what it looks like!

The game won't be rated 18+ on Steam since Vanilla mode will always be active. Vanilla mode is a feature which disables nudity content. You can apply a free patch to overcome this by downloading it on generalpractitionergame.com once the game releases.


General Practitioner 2: are you ready to become a doctor again?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/f569d3c6bb0fb279abca48dfc910ae8e8ae74b83.jpg[/img]

Hit the "Add to wishlist" button if you want to support us in this release and share the love!

notes.title: General Practitioner for Unicef
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow doctors.

The last few days have seen a new war raging up in Europe, with newsfeeds talking about all the people who are now facing this dark page of human history once more. Also, we don't want to forget every war which is now taking place in so many countries, and the wounds it brings to the civilian population.

I am not a politician, nor an expert of international diplomacy, I am just a humble programmer who gets a living from developing videogames to entertain people. I have my opinions about the current scenario, of course, but I doubt they would interest you.

What I can do, what everyone can do now, is to think about countless children everywhere who are facing fear, starvation and death, and I decided this is a time like any other to do something about it.

That's why 50% of General Practitioner's sales in March, and 100% of the pledges to my Patreon Page https://patreon.com/brunimultimedia for the next month will go to UNICEF to try and ease some of those situations.

I'd like to do even more than that, unfortunately Bruni Multimedia is not a big company, and that's what I can afford to do right now.

It's just a drop in the ocean, but every drop counts. If you already own the game you can pledge on Patreon, or send a donation here: https://www.paypal.me/brunimultimedia 

At the end of the month I will send a report of how much has been gathered by this. You can then unsubscribe from Patreon whenever you want, it's easy and with no costs.

Thank you to whoever helps on this.

ANDREA

notes.title: General Practitioner 2.1 - Ultra HD remaster
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow doctors!

To celebrate Winter Sales I am glad to announce you that GP has been updated with patch 2.1, which is a full, free, remaster of the game in Ultra HD definition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/464551c0faff26ea7abb56efc20f747e4aef3b22.jpg[/img]

When I first started to develop this game in 2017 I was using my home computer, which was not a professional device by any means. That meant I had to choose a resolution which would not have hindered my chances to render dozens of images each month, update after update.

The game was not aging that well, though, since HD-Ready resolution was starting to get a little strange to look at. That's why I decided to remaster the game at a higher, Ultra HD definition (2k).

Of course the game will automatically adapt itself to lower resolutions if your screen doesn't support it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/f4835521e8d0eade9b66ec49956eb1670c9240ca.jpg[/img]

The images of the game were not re-rendered, of course, as it would've meant redoing the whole game from scratch. However, all have been upscaled using AI technologies which filled the pixel gap in the images.

Some of them benefit more than others, especially the older renders, but I believe the overall visual quality of the game improved a lot. A couple images have been rendered from scratch, and I plan to re-render more of them as you report any issue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/d1fa35c37c05d827b6b44842fc0175f166c423e0.jpg[/img]

There are more than 6000 images in General Practitioner and although I made sure all of them were upscaled (did I mentioned that the sex videos have been upscaled as well? :D), some of them might have slipped my checks. I apologize in advance, please let me know about that issue if you meet any.

The work also made me redefine the size and coordinates for each interactable item on the examinations screens, menus, and examination reports. That also means that some number might have slipped as well, so please report them as well. Please do remember I'm working on the game alone, and every test I do I make on my own.

Wishing you a merry christmas, now it's the perfect time to buy General Practitioner with the Winter Sales discount! And in Ultra HD!

notes.title: Patch 2.1 will include improved graphics
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow doctors!

Today I'm announcing you the new patch for General Practitioner, which will fix more issues with the game and introduce a new 2560x1440 max resolution.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/f4835521e8d0eade9b66ec49956eb1670c9240ca.jpg[/img]

The game is more than 4 years old now, and while a Visual Novel doesn't need 2k or 4k graphic to be enjoyable, that is not the reason why GP is just 1280x720 pixel.

When I started developing this game back in 2017 I had a very limited hardware and relied on sending the images to render to an external website with a very slow internet connection as well! In time I improved my hardware and started developing games in 1920x1080 which is now the standard resolution I use in Yomi Alliance and other games as well.

General Practitioner isn't aging very well in 1280, so I decided to upgrade it a little.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/d1fa35c37c05d827b6b44842fc0175f166c423e0.jpg[/img]

You can see some differences above. The overall look of the game is less grainy and colors are more intense, especially on newer monitors. Some images benefit from that more than others, but the game has been improved throughout.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/4ed64025537866c30bce1f2b5f2c3ccd8f4d592e.jpg[/img]

This doesn't mean I re-rendered all the images in 2k resolution, but it means the older images have been upscaled with an IA to add pixels and preserve the original aspect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/23df377a80661e2385ee618e78c56d672bf04bec.jpg[/img]

This will also mean that the newest DLCs will get the new resolution right from the start, improving the quality of each release.

I am also planning to re-do some of the very old images and those which definitely need some re-doing, but that will come on a later patch. Of course the user interface has been upscaled as well.

I hope you'll enjoy the new graphic for the game when 2.1 will be out, ideally in a couple weeks.

Stay safe and healthy, and thank you for your support!

notes.title: About Emergency Procedures and its price tag
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow doctors.

Since EP has been launched a few hours ago, I met with some vocal disappointment from some of you who are unsure about the pricing of the DLC, which varies over the different countries and it's about 5$ in the U.S.

I remember telling you in the past that the DLC was going to be free, like Teaching Medicine was. Well, that was my intention up until June, however as I kept working on this and as I tried as hard as I could to deliver some quality content (even better than TM was), I realized I had to charge something for it, keeping it as low as I could.

I won't tell you again the reason for this, as I stated in earlier news about the current situation for the games. I am working primarily on Yomi Alliance right now, and other VNs have been published, and a brand new one will be released around Christmas. Keeping doing my job in these difficult times is tough, as for everybody, and I apologize if my communication about this wasn't very straightforward.

Of course, I gain nothing by telling you the DLC is for free and then putting a price tag on it, so it's pretty clear it was just a mistake on my part not announcing a price tag earlier. While I cannot do anything about it, I can only hope you will give EP a chance and play it, as it was made with passion and love for this game.

Your support, the players' support, is the only thing that can make me continue in this line of work, and since I am not a big studio but a single dev, it would be quite suicidal on my part to alienate my fan base over 5$. You know I offered you a refund even when Steam didn't allow for it, I kept updating games that are years old, I am still reading through the forums to fix bugs and stuff but, sometimes, I make mistakes as I'm just human. The mistake wasn't putting a price on the DLC, which I think it's worth the price, but more so not telling about it over the past few days, since I was excited to introduce you with the news about the game itself.

I hope you will give the Doctor, and the game, a chance. I thought about writing this announcement for some time before publishing it, but I thought I owe you an explanation.

That said, I hope you'll enjoy the game.

Stay safe and healthy, and thank you for your invaluable feedback, as usual.

Andrea

Greetings fellow doctors!

It's with great pleasure and joy that I'm announcing you the newest, big update and DLC for General Practitioner: Emergency Procedures! The update features a lot of bugfixes and improvements, as well as preparing the game for the DLC itself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/1cb62fdb34d1428db7f760c1c3c64ddfcb13f1b9.png[/img]

In Emergency Procedures you will enjoy more of the Doctor's personal story with [b]two new romance options[/b] (one male, one female) and many new dialogues and situations.

Enjoy 15 new Emergency cases from drug addicts, to COVID-19 related issues, to sudden death where you can do nothing but relieve the relatives' pain with your human skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/5f640c802174ec433b14ba6f1e50655f5540a5b1.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/c1cb91cfb56bc027c8d4f318059ea20fb24eb207.jpg[/img]

We also provided new music tracks to enjoy during this DLC, to better immerse you in the Doctor's world, and provided new sex scenes to entertain those of you who don't like to play in Vanilla Mode (the game mode without any sexual content.

Oh, and did I mention you can choose between new haircuts and looks for the doctor to play from this DLC and now on? Meaning your choices will impact the future releases of the game. However, due to the nature of the game's rendering engine, you can't change the look of the doctor for the main story mode.

I hope you'll like both the update and the DLC. Your support is still, and always will be, the only way I can keep making games for your entertainment.

notes.title: The Devil's Shoes is releasing on August 16th!
notes.notes:
Greetings to all of you out there!

notes.title: A statement regarding the current state of the game
notes.notes:
Greetings guys!

First of all, thank you for your constant feedback about General Practioner and its issues. I am aware someone believes I abandoned the game, but that is NOT the case. However, I remind you that I'm working on this project on my own, and that there is no studio supporting my work as it relies on players only.

That said, I'm receiving reports I'm going to address, so you know what's going on right now.

[b]GAME NOT STARTING[/b]
Some of you complied about the game not starting overnight. I already tried to start the game from Steam myself, and it works fine. It looks like some configurations have had issues when starting the game, and I'm working on understanding what's going on. [b]You understand that with NO ERROR REPORTS nor every available computer, it is going to take some time for me to understand the issue[/b], which only affects a very rare minority of people, as right now some hundreds of you are playing it (if it was an issue with the game I would have 100% refunds AND 0 people playing, which is not happening).

[b]THE GAME ENGINE[/b]
As many Visual Novels, General Practitioner is written in Ren'Py, which has been recently updated to its latest patch. This might have caused some issues, which caused me to revert to the previous GP's patch. While I apologize for the issue this caused to some of you, I cannot speed up the process of releasing a patch for the engine, as I'm not its proprietor.
I am going to recompile it once more and release a small fix for both GP and Yomi Alliance, and I WILL NEED YOUR REPORTS to know if it's fixing the problem (with achievements as well). Steam also changed its integrated library recently.

As usual, you do understand this huge game has been made by myself only, so I rely on the documentation from both Steam and Ren'Py to make it work. It's entirely in my skills, but it will take some time.

[b]MISSING FILES[/b]
Every time you check for the file integrity you get 100+ files "missing" or needed to be redownloaded. [b][u]THIS IS WORKING AS INTENDED [/u][/b]because of the game's engine, as it writes temporary files every time the game is launched, which of course then differs from the ones in Steam's main repository. This doesn't cause ANY issue with the game, it's not a bug, nor it affects anything, and doesn't mean the game is broken in any way. When you leave a negative review about it, remind that you are basically telling people my game's bad because of some temporary files. You are free to check that the same happens with every ren'py-based Visual Novel out there.

[b]COVID IN ITALY[/b]
The current situation with COVID-19 restrictions in italy severely impacts on my family, thus making it harder to to everything in time. I had to reschedule my next game's launch, a couple patches with Yomi Alliance and voice actors, the creation of my Patreon page AND General Practitioner's next FREE update. I apologize for this, I truly do, but I don't know how to make it better, since it's not my choice to lock us away like they're doing.

[b]This also [u]hugely [/u]impacted my earnings[/b], as well as many people out there. My studio is VERY small (myself only) but I feed my family with it, and of course the budget for my next games (a new Unity-based engine, CGI, interactions) was impacted as well. I was going to launch a kickstarter for my newest projects, but that's out of the question now, since everyone is having a hard time because of the pandemic.

[b]DELAYS AND REFUNDS[/b]
I apologize for any delay in my projects. And I would understand if you like a refund for the game. You can always contact me in my email development[at]brunimultimedia.com, [b]if you disliked the game A LOT, leaving a negative review even after 100+ hours and Steam won't refund it, contact me and I'll send you money via Paypal.[/b]

[u][b]I started this job to entertain people and form a nice community around my games, not to fool them or take their money without giving anything in return. 
[/b][/u]
Even if you liked my game but still want a refund, be my guest. Really.

notes.title: Game reverting to 1.12 - 1.13 in beta tab
notes.notes:
Greetings guys.

Since the latest release of the game had a "False Positive" coming up on many antiviruses, and people are writing negative reviews for something I really cannot control (why aren't the antivirus software getting any bad reviews when they actually fail to do a good job, I wonder), I decided to revert the game back to 1.12 patch. 

Allow me to say this has been a very difficult decision for me, because the game was improving patch after patch, and for some reason the antivirus of so many people decided to go nuts.

I am putting some of the most asked questions down below, please read them through BEFORE posting "bug reports" or, even worse, negative feedback.

[b]STEAM "REPAIR TOOL"[/b]
File detection by Steam update works fine. The "missing" files are created by Ren'Py (the game's engine) and are temporary files which won't affect game's usability. It's completely normal if you get a few hundred files missing, this doesn't mean the game's broken in any way.

[b]CURRENT PATCH[/b]
[b]I just reverted to 1.12 patch since 1.13 was having a "virus issue".[/b]
The "virus" detected was (and is) a [u][b]false positive[/b][/u]. [b]Of course Steam wouldn't allow for a malware to be present in any of its games' builds[/b]. To think I put a malware in my top selling game is senseless.

I just reversed the patch to a prior state, so hopefullly you will be able to play the game now.

[b]WHAT IF I WANT TO PLAY WITH 1.13?[/b]
Most of you had no issue with the latest patch, and would like to play the game to its most recent state. You can do so by opting in for 1.13 Beta in the "Beta" tab for Steam.

Please remember the "CURRENT PATCH" section of this news, as some of you might experience the "virus" issue.

[b]WHEN WILL BE THE UPDATE BACK?[/b]
As soon as either ren'py gets updated to avoid the issue OR the antiviruse software stops signaling for a false positive. Unfortunately there's no way I can speed up the process. I apologize for any discomfort this might cause.

notes.title: Happy new year!
notes.notes:
Greetings to all players and community!

This has been an unique year. And I sincerely hope it stays that way.

Many of my projects have suffered a serious delay, both for [b]personal family issues[/b] which I already told you about in the last few months and that are far from being over, and for [b]economical reasons[/b], of course.  The plan to launch a brand-new [b]Kickstarter campaign[/b] in November was halted, as the world and people are still struggling with the pandemic and its effects on our lives.

Development for my games hasn't stopped a bit, but it was delayed as I had to take care of my children and family, especially while schools were closed and they had to stay home. I managed to release many updates and new stories, and in the next few months more will come with[b] a new Otome Visual Novel[/b], new chapters for [b]The Devil's Shoes[/b], improvements on [b]Yomi Alliance[/b], the [b]2nd free DLC for General Practitioner[/b] and[b] two new episodes of The Coroner Saga[/b], which are already written and only need some polish.

New rewards are also available for Patrons on my [url=https://patreon.com/brunimultimedia]Patreon page[/url], and they will keep getting released over and over. I think that would be the best way to thank you for your support, despite my setbacks which are not due to my will but which I apologize for, regardless.

[b]Developing a videogame, even a Visual Novel, is a very costly effort[/b], and you only see results months after you spend those money. For a single-man company like mine this is more than a challenge at times, and that's why [b]I completely rely on your support[/b] and your appreciation of my work to keep doing what I do: develop games to entertain you in the best of times, and in the worst of times.

[b]So, thank you for your support, past, present and future. Without you, there won't be any Bruni Multimedia to talk about and no videogames at all from me.[/b]

I hope you can live a happier year, we're going through this together, as the Doctor told during the "Coronavirus Exam" released last February (my, it's already a full year!).

Happy new year to everyone. Keep following me, because there will be tons of news coming up in the next few days

Stay safe, and healthy!

Today I'm glad to announce you the next actor which will lend his voice to a character in Yomi Alliance. I'm talking about the amazing Yoshi Vu and his character, Dr. Li.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36027277/9569c3d5656b782d868495a17740656cc44ab2d8.jpg[/img]

[b]Yoshi Vu[/b] was born and raised in Texas, where he was always artistically inclined, having won the Scholastic Art Award in the 7th grade and continued experimenting in different mediums before moving to California for High School and joining the United States Marine Corps.  

Yoshi then started attending art school while still serving in the military, eventually earning his first major industry contract with [b]Pixomondo[/b], working on [b]Journey 2[/b], and assisting with [b]Green Lantern[/b].  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36027277/b36b5d9764aa4825ea5ab5c2d63e5572028bf643.png[/img]

He has since continued his career in film, branching out to games as well, having the opportunity to work on [b]Call of Duty: Black Ops 3[/b] at Treyarch before moving to television with [b]The Walking Dead[/b], [b]The Orville[/b], and several other shows before making his way back to film, where he served as a Senior Generalist on [b]Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker[/b], and the first season of [b]The Mandalorian[/b].  

In addition to work as an artist, Yoshi has also participated in various projects as an actor, stunt performer, or even a voice acting. He works closely with his friend [b]Manu Intiraymi[/b], another Yomi Alliance cast member, and the two have been in various projects together, both in front of the camera or behind the scenes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36027277/9ce4741ea4829bb2a1c0dd982152f694c8c20356.png[/img]

notes.title: New content preview - DLC pre-patch 1.9
notes.notes:
Greetings!

Getting to work to General Practitioner is always lovely, and also a little strange. This is the first game I made with Ren'Py and there are lots of things I am not doing nowadays, either because I learned how to use the engine properly, and also because I found more efficient ways to do things.

Also, the different resolution of the images and the way they are managed are often misleading when I have to put them on-screen, and that makes everything more difficult than writing scenes for Yomi Alliance or The Devil's Shoes.

If you wish to learn more about my coding behind-the-scenes just pledge to [url=https://patreon.com/brunimultimedia]my Patreon page[/url], each month I will reveal some interesting stuff to my loyal pledgers ;)

Now, getting back into business, I want to introduce you to some new stuff introduced by patch 1.9, a pre-patch for the upcoming DLC "Emergency Procedures", with an introduction to its story and medical stuff.

[list]
[*] Meet Jessica Wilson in a brand-new, different medical exam which will feature a lot of conversation choices and consequences upon your fame, money and what will happen in the Emergency Procedures DLC as well

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/cd2c97c5a7c179e80c959fd66c5be0f0252f809e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/0b863cda306ed3814a2173730993d63257a7635d.png[/img]

[*] Meet Bryan Calhoun, Dr. Benedetta Borelli's former boyfriend and head of St. Francis Emergency Services. Provided you hired Dr. Borelli into your staff, this medical examination will pave the way to the Doctor's involvement into the events of "Emergency Procedures" DLC, with direct consequences on its story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/96670ec7337e82d6bed2e9e8594682f79bb4db06.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/f699c4ff2a483a78df7c156e6ef1cd027e05dc10.png[/img]

[*] The Strip Learning minigame will be made available to owners of "Teaching Medicine" free DLC. This was an intended feature in the base DLC which never made it to the final release because it wasn't working properly as intended.

notes.title: Update 1.8.1 is available - Visual Novel Mode!
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow doctors!

It's with great pleasure that I'm announcing you update 1.8.1 of General Practitioner. It adds many interesting stuff for the game, fixes some nasty persistent bugs and also introduces you [b]new characters[/b] and a brand [b]new medical exam[/b]!

[b]VISUAL NOVEL MODE[/b]
You can now start a new game in Visual Novel Mode, meaning you will play the story without medical examinations, moving from one chapter to the next one and choosing who to pursue as a romantic interest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/7e9ce6bda1ee2332c863c246c5357d2c7a39c5f7.png[/img]

Visual Novel mode is more than just a re-cut of content: the whole game has been revisited and improved, conversations have been added, the overall pacing of the story has increased and fixes have been applied. We made every effort to give players who already tried the game once to experiment more paths in a simpler way.

Whenever a "RED" dialogue option appears, it means that's a "Path Point", meaning you will choose the romantic partner with that dialogue and that choice will accompany you through the rest of the game. You cannot change the romantic path once started (the "Story Mode" will keep allowing you to do so, this is limited to Visual Novel mode only).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/bc6fa889c1864232b4f804231125e0b1cc12f0ca.png[/img]

[b]NEW RITA, NON-NTR STORY[/b]
As promised some time ago, Rita's NTR path has been made optional by a setting in the Preferences Screen. You can now live your romantic relationship with her without worrying too much about other guys having an affair with her.

Dialogues with Rita have changed, a new ending has been added as well as two different events and sexual situations. Explore the new path in both Story and Visual Novel mode!

[b]NEW MEDICAL EXAMINATION: KAVITHA[/b]
As a reward for pledging on our patreon page, you can write down and ask for a medical exam to be introduced in the game. Kavitha is such a reward and you can enjoy her medical examination helped by a medical student named Jamal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/9ad79412dec3418d449843e5b45b0e715cb73526.png[/img]

Follow Kavitha's story and enjoy this fresh, sexy content in both Exam Mode and Story Mode!

A lot of improvements have been made throughout the game. I hope you'll enjoy them. The game is constantly being updated with new content, for free.

[b]PRICE INCREASE FOR THE GAME[/b]
As the game gets more and more content it is planned to increase its price a little. The price stayed this way since Alpha release 0.0.18 but it also received many big updates, and more are coming. Those of you who already own the game should worry not, as they will receive every update for free. 

For the others I suggest you to grab a copy during the upcoming summer sales, as the game will receive a nice discount! The new price for the game will be 19,99$ (and regional equivalents) starting from after the Summer Sales. Of course this doesn't apply to current owners of the game.

Thanks a lot for your understanding!

Please check the full changelog below for further info!

Thank you so much for your support!

Be safe and healthy!

notes.title: General Practitioner: Emergency Procedures DLC Announcement

notes.title: Visual Novel Mode
notes.notes:
Greetings guys!

Today I'm announcing you a feature that many of you requested both here and on Patreon's forums: the Visual Novel Mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/4608969e7c44527af7f7fa688443af3dfb367e9a.png[/img]

Adding to the already existing "Story Mode" and "Examination Mode", this gameplay option will have you play the game without the simulation part. This means that story events will flow one after another, taking each branch of the story as a consequence of your decisions. You can play the game once more after you finished it, or start a new game skipping each and every examination.

Don't bother about patients, money, hiring people, go to gym and various activities, just enjoy the story and play it again more times to experiment newer paths.

In Visual Novel mode you won't be able to earn achievements on the Steam release, nor will you be able to have more than one romantic interest at a given time, meaning that romance choices will stay active until the end of the game. Whenever  you're making a choice that will be permanent it will be highlighted in purple.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/11b0b865ee20a2bb6571ab017e287c2b68ec5cf0.jpg[/img]

Visual Novel mode is more than just a copy-paste of content. Conversations have been revisited to fit the new story flow and even dating your romantic interest has been included with new dialogues and images.

You will be able to play "Visual Novel" mode with patch 1.8. 

Keep following me for more updates about the release date!

Stay safe and healthy,

notes.title: The current COVID-19 situation and our games
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It's very strange to write this stuff, but I think you deserve to know the behind-the-scenes of the current situation in Italy, the place where I live and work.

The lockdown announced by the government fortunately doesn't include my job, so I can keep developing all my games (as you can see by the updates I published yesterday and the day before).

However, it would be false to state that it doesn't affect my production at all. The streets are empty as they are on holiday weeks, right now I can still access my office but I don't know for how long (I can still work from home, but it would be VERY difficult), plus I'm overall concerned for my family and kids, and writing videogames with that kind of mental stress is sometimes difficult. But I'm trying to do my best, as I always did. And I just hope the situation won't be worse than this in the future.

Plus, with most services out of order and the invitation to go out by oneself and without other family members, I have to take care of many things personally, which is something that takes time and it's a time I can't work at all (buying groceries, bills, managing bank accounts, buying medicines and playing with my kids since the schools are closed).

So, some updates of the game could be delivered with a delay in the near future. I am VERY sorry about this and believe me I'm doing the best I can to ensure you'll receive everything smoothly as I always did in the last three years (BTW, the 3-year anniversary for General Practitioner is coming on May and there will be surprises for everyone!)

That's it. I just wanted you to know the current situation and why I'm more silent than ever on social media channels: right now all my energies are focused on developing stories, not talking about them.

Thank you for your support. I hope this situation will defuse soon and without long-lasting consequences. BTW for those of you who still don't know I published a "Coronavirus Update" on General Practitioner a while ago. It's not meant to inform people about the situation, it's just meant to smile and be a "doctor Casanova" despite everything :)

Be safe and healthy, now more than ever!

ANDREA BRUNI

[b]Supporting the Early Access game will allow me to keep producing more exciting content for you[/b], as of course my studio is very (very) small and developing a videogame certainly costs a lot. That's why Early Accesses are released, and that's why supporting them helps all developers - but [b]especially indie ones[/b] - a lot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36027277/802df3f2cf65cc547312e7fd7a2d759c67e4af7a.png[/img]

notes.title: Dealing with a very rare, elusive, completely random bug
notes.notes:
It's almost 3 AM and I just finished wrapping up the latest bug fixes for release 1.3, and there are many fixes you'll find "minor" but are somewhat important to the overall experience of the game.

A few days ago I released 1.3 but had to remove it almost immediately because of some issues it was giving to some players. We're talking about 10 people out of a few hundred, so the numbers are very few, nevertheless I put on a Beta branch and I'm still trying to figure out what caused the issue in the first place.

It was reported that, in very rare cases, saved games could behave erratically after applying this patch (i.e. right-clicking, hitting ESC not working properly). 
I made a fix to try to overcome this issue, even though the error appears so randomly that it's almost impossible to understand its origin. Still, new games are not affected by it and you should be able to play the game by loading it without problems. To achieve that I had to reset any customized setting (i.e. fullscreen, skip options, vanilla mode etc.) upon loading a game saved before 1.3, sorry for any discomfort this might cause.

In case you are still affected by the issue after I release the patch: 
[list]
[*] just try and reload an earlier saved game. The problem has been reported to disappear just like it appeared.
[*] Checking the game's integrity with the Steam's client is also recommended in case of any trouble.
[/list]

While some of you might even laugh at a developer who can't find his own bugs, I assure you this is more slippery than it seems, because of the few people actually affected and because every game I tried, even after loading allegedly corrupted games was completely bug-free.

Of course I could also tell you that older saves are incompatible and that would be it. Many games actually do it after major releases (i.e. Stellaris, to name one) and I believe that's fine, but it wouldn't be true, because loading a game actually works for most people!

Since the issue wasn't reported for a while, I decided to release 1.3 tomorrow, as it brings so many new features I'm very excited to share with you. 

Just tell me if you experience the bug by writing at bugs(at)brunimultimedia.com after trying the above solutions. Thank you for enjoying the game, I hope you'll have fun with it for a long time.

ANDREA

notes.title: Yomi Alliance Devlog: Acquiring Skills
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow officers!

Today I'm going to introduce you on the different ways to acquire skills in Yomi Alliance, which is hopefully a fun, non-grinding way to achieve your objectives and increase your character's stats.

Like some of you already played in the demo, each week you are going to schedule your activities, choosing to pursue your social interests, your training and/or attending classes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36027277/df3ee1c2263dbad748471bcf282a4ce327b282ff.png[/img]

Attending classes will raise your stats from the starting point up to 13 points. While some classes are automatic (you increase your points without any other interaction), many others will feature an in-game event as well.
Let's take three skills for example: [b]Psychology [/b]training for Counselor career and [b]Inquire [/b]training for Security Officers and finally [b]Diplomacy [/b]for the Command School candidate.

As for Psychology your teacher, Counselor Lapp, will ask you questions about simulated patients. You will need to listen to her question carefully, and also deal with patients who are going to tell you about their problems and try the best way to solve them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36027277/300fdc5dc667518e55052d0cf1cc181084607551.png[/img]
You will increase your Stats while also playing the role you chose when starting the game.

[b]Inquire [/b]is a little different. While it plays the same dialogue-choice-consequence pattern, you will be tasked with a real interview of an alien volounteer with his own mini-storyline taking place. Your choices won't just grant you skill points but will develop a shady sub-plot which will finally unveil in the last class session.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36027277/13cf22b1cc0770aa1ba41f4efcfc3e2040070150.png[/img]

Even [b]Diplomacy [/b]aims to bring you a different point of view. This time you will take the role of a famous Fuminoid Captain of the past in a Virtual Reality environment and you will be tasked to negotiate peace within two warring factions. Your choices could bring more chaos into their society or end up with a long-lasting peace treaty and Alliance application.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36027277/9c4487247fa9089e6da7ab038a0f52ded3d1e342.png[/img]

Your character will learn the best way to handle first contact with an alien species directly on the field.

You can expect varied stories and gameplay for many different skills as each update is released. The first Early Access update features dozens of events, social time with Serena, a couple sex scenes, an academy storyline with many events and so on. 

The whole point of different career paths is to get you something different each time you play Yomi Alliance. Psychology classes, for example, are just for the "Counseling" career and related professions, so you might not play any of them on your first playthrough.

As you will start a new game and choose new paths, species and background you will unlock more and more events, many of which you never saw before!

Of course the game will get more content update after update, but there's enough stuff to keep you entertained for many hours right away.

[b]Yomi Alliance will hit Steam's Early Access on February 10th, 2020![/b] Wishlist it today and keep following us!

Thank you for your support!

Be safe and healthy,

notes.title: General Practitioner update 1.3 Beta Branch
notes.notes:
An update for General Practitioner is available for download as a Beta Branch.

[b]WARNING:[/b]

Beta Branch is for testing the latest update only. Make a copy of your save games as they might become corrupted if playing with a Beta release patch.

If you wish to participate in the open beta, you can find this version in the public_beta branch on Steam. The way to access it is as follows: Steam client → LIBRARY → right-click on General Practitioner → Properties → Betas tab → 1_3_Beta. No password is required.

Please report any issue with this release. The need for a Beta arose as some users experienced errors when loading a game or hitting "ESC" / Right click to access the menu. [u]Your feedback is important.[/u]

[list]
[*] Clicking anywhere when displaying a dialogue during online shopping won't result in accidental selections anymore
[*] Fixed an issue which made the game refer to male children as "girl"
[*] Fixed a missing image during Aaron's Three's a Crowd conversation
[*] Winning the most difficult challenge against Koola in the gym will now grant you 1000$ as intended (from 100)
[*] Fixed a crashing issue during Dwayne's examination
[*] Fixed an inconsistency with a dialogue line from "Living Together" chapter if you didn't invite Claudia to the Festival
[*] Fixed an inconsistent line of dialogue regarding a promise you made to Claudia if you never made it in the first place
[*] Fixed inconsistencies during Medical Board's advice on Kamil's first examination
[*] Fixed inconsistencies with Erika's advice during some random examinations
[*] The Interactive phone has been restored from earlier alpha builds.
[*] New Game+ has been introduced in the game. To unlock it you will need to finish the game at least once (up to the point where end credits are shown) and to Start a new game. The game will then ask you if you wish to start from scratch or from a New game plus.

New Game+ retains your money, medical items bought, relationship levels with every potential romance (except Christina) and skills. It will also unlock the Waiting Room right from the beginning. 
It will NOT include people you met in the game nor already performed exams and events. Other events (pool subscription, gym subscription, Norah's meeting) are not unlocked.

[*] An option to choose which chapter to play has been added to the game.

You can go to the Church to "Meditate on your life" and choose a specific chapter to jump to, even previously played ones. 

Please be aware that skipping makes the game to assume certain choices have been made by default. As the in-game calendar isn't updated (that's because events can play in different days depending on choices), it also advances events ahead of time, so you could end up playing the "Christmas Dinner" event in June for example. I recommend you to use it after you finished the game at least once.

Also, many events that depend on your romance paths (i.e. Elisa's whole pregnancy story) are not available to skip upon, since not setting the proper variables would cause the game to behave erratically. 
Ultimately, this feature is not the proper way to play the game and it could lead to unexpected behavior.

[*] Added the "Experienced Doctor" achievement unlockable by starting a New Game Plus
[/list]


Thank you for playing the game!

Be safe and healthy,

notes.title: New Game+ and Chapter Selection
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow doctors!

[b]General Practitioner launch was a huge success for the game[/b], I really didn't expect so many people would've played the game and for a very small software house like mine (I'm basically developing the whole game by myself) it's a very exciting surprise!

Of course, [b]releasing the game also brought some issues[/b], as the many months of alpha and beta testing were apparently not enough to cancel every bug from the game. Still, the game is very big and with lots of branches and choices and it took me some time to find and fix everything. This is NOT an excuse but a sincere explanation of what happened in the first few days.

[b]I apologize for any discomfort you might have experienced while playing the game.[/b]

[b]I already released a number of fixes which took care of the most annoying bugs[/b] (the first one on the very first day of release) and reports of annoyed players dropped a lot.

[b]I am also listening to your feedback[/b] of course, because like I promised General Practitioner is not being abandoned after release, on the contrary you can expect a lot of free patches and DLCs in the future.

With the upcoming 1.3 patch I'm going to release in a few hours more bugs will be solved. Not only that: [b] I'm also introducing two new functions to the game[/b]:

[b]New Game Plus[/b]
To unlock this feature you will need to finish the game at least once (up to the point where end credits are shown) and start a new game. A menu prompt will then ask you if you wish to start from scratch or from a New game plus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/127d42ac4fcc5224b3c54359943b36a1eb895747.png[/img]

New Game+ retains the following informations for your new game:
[list]
[*] Money
[*] Medical Items owned
[*] Relationship Levels with Romance partners (except Christina)
[*] Skills
[*] Waiting Room unlocks
[/list]

It will NOT include people you met in the game nor already performed exams and events as they are part of the story. For the same reason other events such as pool subscription, gym subscription, Norah's meeting etc., are not unlocked.

[b]Chapter Selection[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/22e7af63a1cefc86cb791d50a99c680ab35b3e9f.png[/img]

An option to choose which chapter to play has been added to the game.

You can go to the Church to "Meditate on your life" and choose a specific chapter to jump to, even previously played ones. 

Please be aware that skipping makes the game to assume certain choices have been made by default. As the in-game calendar isn't updated (that's because events can play in different days depending on choices), it also advances events ahead of time, so you could end up playing the "Christmas Dinner" event in June for example. I recommend you to use it after you finished the game at least once.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/3d8acca8e86be181593db1083b52c89971927039.png[/img]

Also, many events that depend on your romance paths (i.e. Elisa's whole pregnancy story) are not available to skip upon, since not setting the proper variables would cause the game to behave erratically. 

Ultimately, this feature is not the proper way to play the game and it could lead to unexpected behavior. Still, if you wish to play chapters you never saw in your first playthrough without needing to re-play the whole game, this feature is what you're looking for.

New chapters will be added in future updates, so stay tuned.

[b]I hope you're enjoying the game, I'm working hard on it and on Yomi Alliance as well, to bring you dozens of hours of fun. If you enjoy your time with my games, then my goal has been reached![/b]

Be safe and healthy,

ANDREA

notes.title: Where are we going next... to the stars, to hell and beyond!
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow doctors!

As General Practitioner is approaching its Beta and Final Release due in December, we started planning our game development future for the foreseeable future, and we're excited to announce you a few projects we have in store, the first of which will be Alpha-Ready when GP will be finalized.

2020 will be full of projects I'm very excited about:
- [b]Yomi Alliance[/b]: a sci-fi Adult RPG/Visual Novel (see next)
- [b]The Coroner Saga[/b]: Episodes 3, 4 and 5
- New DLCs and updates for [b]General Practitioner[/b], many of which for free
- [b]The Devil's Shoes[/b], a brand new 8 hours long erotic videogame
- [b]The Interview[/b], a General Practitioner erotic spinoff 6 hours long

While some of our projects will be announced on a later date, today I want you to know about [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160950/Yomi_Alliance/]Yomi Alliance[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/3ad34076fd6ba1914394280c653e65623c82da37.png[/img]

This project is ambitious, even bigger than General Practitioner. You can see informations about it on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160950/Yomi_Alliance/][b]Steam Page[/b][/url] and the [url=www.yomialliance.space][b]Official Website[/b][/url]

Featuring dozens of hours of gameplay, you will experience a different game every time you run a playthrough, since every career choice and even your starting species will determine different outcomes in conversations, actual gameplay and situations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/22a3387c3f308b85275762cac3150aecb5111e3b.png[/img]

A project this big will need some time to be completed of course, and a lot of money as well. That's why we're starting the Alpha Early Access in December and we're also launching a [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/brunimultimedia/yomi-alliance-an-epic-sci-fi-visual-novel]Kickstarter[/url] for the project on October 31st!

Supporting us on Kickstarter and/or [url=www.patreon.com/generalpractitioner]Patreon[/url] ensures us to keep doing our job: creating different kinds of Visual Novels and make you enjoy them for many hours for the months to come!
All Patreon rewards have been changed to reflect the new releases, so you can take a look to them as well, even though of course the Kickstarter crowdfunding is the best way to show us your support (and earn a Free Steam Key as well).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/9b69f7573ec3a7540fc5593b14d60d62bcc1679d.png[/img]

[b]You can apply for the Kickstarter from October 31st to November 30th, 2019[/b].

[b]A DEMO of the game will be available on October 31st[/b] on Steam as well. The demo will feature the first fours Academy Weeks and one of the first Away Missions. You can choose any of the four species and three genders in the demo and a career of your choice between Command and Science.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/df3ee1c2263dbad748471bcf282a4ce327b282ff.png[/img]

Alpha release in December will feature a FULL Academy training section (about 20+ hours of gameplay) and every month we'll release further content with priority release for our crowdfunders.

We're very excited about this opportunity, we hope you'll keep following us, supporting us and always be safe and healthy!

Thank you.

notes.title: DEVELOPMENT LOG #29: City and Clinic Map
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow doctors!

Amongst the final changes made to the game I'm reviewing the User Interface. Too many people believe this is something less important than actual gameplay or story script, while I learned from the best developers that it's a very important part of the game, just like a good musical score!

One of the oldest interfaces in the game was the "Daily Choice Screen" and the "Clinic Choice Screen". Basically you had to click once onto the clinic, then another screen would appear and you had to choose again what to do.

While navigating the city the screens could even be more than two, making the whole operation very annoying for some players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/e15313f705e1ab9bc05cf5e1aa7db398e334df32.png[/img]

0.0.30 update will feature two brand-new maps: the city map (so that you can have an idea on how the city the doctor's lives in looks like) and the clinic map, showing you what it means to be inside St. Mary's clinic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/ce13834f16934d048a39a34cd786a85a879edfdd.png[/img]

A tooltip will of course appear while moving the mouse over an icon, showing you what will happen if you choose a specific place.

I hope you'll like this small but important improvement of the game!

Be safe and healthy, thank you for being with me in this journey!

notes.title: DEVLOG #28: All good things...
notes.notes:
[b]All good things must come to an end...[/b] And that's not as easy as it might seem.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/cc47dbb29f9dc5ec4c47d5610dc8b52329969c4a.jpg[/img]

General Practitioner is approaching its 30th major patch release on Patreon and soon it will be available for every player as well. We're in the middle of finalizing the script, adding images and fixing the most obvious bugs, which is a bigger step in development than many might think.

0.0.30 will also mark the last Alpha Release of the game, which will enter Beta in November with 0.1.0 and finally in final release in December. I took many decisions about the game and here I am announcing them to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/577f90a61ef6678713200fc416b5092cceb4a217.jpg[/img]

First of all, [b]I had to draw a line[/b]: many improvements can still be made in the game's story, so much content can still be added (side stories for other characters, more patients, more items in the store, etc.) and many will be added when Beta hits the shelves! Still, [b]I think it's also time to finalize the game in its current state[/b], taking a full month to polish it from bugs and other issues (which are very minor right now) and seeing how the game can walk on its own.

This of course means that I had to cut something that just wasn't working properly in terms of script and gameplay. 

[list]
[*] The "Gallery" feature will be removed from the Main Menu as it was never properly developed and most people have no use for it (you can take a screenshot of everything in the game hiding the interface by pressing "H" on your keyboard).
[*] Father Torque's "mission" was added in 0.0.4 but it doesn't add anything to the Doctor's story, character or choices. While I also wrote the examination for the road worker guy you're supposed to steal underwear from, it just didn't work. And sometimes we, as writers, need to accept something we're writing is not fitting the whole opera and cut it out.
[*] The settings screen won't show support for other languages anymore. Unfortunately we never reached our crowdfunding goal to start translating the game in any language, and GP will stay an english-only Visual Novel for the time being (it was never posted anywhere around the game's promotional pages that a localization would be added, to be honest).
[*] Some endings will be rewritten to fit the new content added in 0.0.30, which means the "main story" of the game. If you thought the endings were only bad ones, that's because they lacked some part of the story, especially Claudia's and Erika's
[/list]

While [b]we started the preliminary work on our newest project[/b] (you will see the details very soon, and [b]we'll need your help with its kickstarter[/b]), this doesn't mean General Practitioner will cease updates from December, on the contrary it will receive patches, new DLCs (most of them free) with new content and many updates for months or even years to come!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/1c1c89c5ed67d2ee6dead7133f3f7f34309de851.png[/img]

[b]We love this project, it's our firstborn Visual Novel, and we'll keep updating it beyond it's final release. 

So stay with us, keep following us and, if you like what we're doing in our Visual Novels, keep supporting our work![/b]

We hope you'll enjoy our game's updates as we're enjoying developing them!

notes.title: Development Log #27: Staff Conversations
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/df377a62016466d0ffb850805aec80ae2b357828.png[/img]

As the game is getting more and more polished with each update, I'm adding elements that weren't "necessary" to gameplay but that I think are a nice addition nevertheless.

This time I'm talking about staff conversations with your hired staff members. Whenever you go to the clinic you'll have a chance to meet one of your employees and share a small conversation with them. They will greet you and share their thoughts about topics related to their field of work.

Of course more staff members you hire and more conversations will happen.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/4a5b0c61a41c83f76194ac598a4a5e57074bd868.png[/img]

Phrases are randomly chosen, so sometimes it will happen for some conversations to repeat themselves (there are about 10 for each "area" of work such as midwives, technicians etc.), and more will be added in future updates as well.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/8b564d250ea72f10e37107f0621ca5426aa63eef.png[/img]

While this is probably a "minor" feature within the game, I think it adds to the game's background and immersion, as staff members won't be inactive NPC but people you work with. Further improvements to staff members and their management are planned after the final release of the game, but that's for another Devlog to disclose.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/e1c43d702bd68f3d6a5f192e91463ec17da711db.png[/img]

As always, thank you for following, supporting and playing the game! I hope you'll like this new layer of simulation.

notes.title: Development Log #26: The right to be happy
notes.notes:
One of the most interesting relationships you can pursue in General Practitioner is Kiko's. This girl was not one of the main characters planned for the game when it started development as it was introduced on a later patch after one of our Patreon pledgers asked for her as a reward for his support.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/bde590e9be1c692c75657c9ca4123ed1d2d64057.jpg[/img]

As every other patient's request made in time by Patrons, she had to come, be examined and then disappear from the game for good, giving the player a choice to blackmail her or not after her examination. However, I saw many possibilities to explore her character, which is quite different from any other in the game, with a very strong and distinct personality.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/fcceb10fce23d945be4ef1a664fd4dcd78b782de.jpg[/img]

She is also very young, being only 18 the first time you meet her, and this makes for a series of awkward situations with you being very older. In fact, her father, introduced in the "Shady Business update", is somewhat around your age and this gave the doctor a chance to play Casanova with Mrs. Xuan as well. If you resist that urge, though, Kiko will become in time more and more attracted by you, up to the point where is father takes the situation under his control.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/44ae0af4af3975574418bd12fb8a2b03f2940031.png[/img]

As the Head of a traditional family, with Chinese and Japanes cultures intermixed, he wants to make sure that the new "boyfriend" of Kiko is up to the task, and will try everything he can to split you for good. He will bully the doctor up to a point where you could have to do certain "favors" to him.

Until 0.0.29 you won't have much choice, once you're in with Mr. Xuan you stick with him for good, but with the upcoming update this might change.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/cac8432e47abebe146d8031fdadc1ad70a9c6454.jpg[/img]

Facing 5 new different chapters and tasks to earn Mr. Xuan's trust and respect, you will have to save (or get someway else) a lot of money to impress him, you will visit Japan on a short trip with Kiko to learn more about her and her family, and you will be asked to train in Tang Soo Do martial art to show him you can become more than you actually are.

Performing these tasks will get you free from Mr. Xuan's latches once and for all, and give you a chance of an happy ending with Kiko. Unless you actually betray Mr. Xuan when dealing with...

No spoiler, the Main Storyline is yet to be released. Keep following me for further updates!

notes.notes:
Update 0.0.29 is underway development and there are many interesting things I want you to know about it! The first one being yet another consequence to some of your actions during the game, from a very early medical exam. If you end it in a specific way this new hospital exam will play, where our John Doe is found unconscious and with stains of blood all over his shirt and brought to the ER.

notes.title: Development Log #24: Narrating Pregnancy
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/bfd731aee15c3563d21ab86c394478d5553468a7.jpg[/img]

Update 0.0.28, which is due to release in late August/Early September will focus on Elisa's story. Those of you who have already started her path might have noticed how she can become pregnant by the Doctor during his trip to Seattle early in the game.

The Doctor's parenthood isn't automatic: you need to make the right choices for it to happen, and if he isn't the father Elisa will go back to her former boyfriend, Officer Kirby.

If the story progresses though you will be left to choose if you want to become a father in the game and then her story unfolds as her pregnancy progresses and she approaches her delivery date.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/61bb6676411d6829401420fdaec5ea54c372c3dc.jpg[/img]

Let me tell you that narrating pregnancy isn't easy. The risk to fall in abused clichés is way too easy, even more than talking about homosexuality in general, and those who haven't experienced this part of life can barely guess what it means, because it's something that needs to be lived to be fully understood (I realized that AFTER my wife's own pregnancies myself).

Over the course of the game you will face conversations, challenges and moments of despair, but also fun and joy. Those are the feelings that accompany every parent-to-be, no matter what. I tried to put those in the game by talking about my own experiences and traslating them inside the game, keeping Elisa's mood intact as well as the doctor's.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/bb505ac27ac139ad5dfb06d9b7d6e70e55d275b4.jpg[/img]

In terms of gameplay a new meter has been added: the Stress Meter. Elisa will become more or less stressed during her pregnancy and this will ultimately lead to different outcomes when ending her story arc. It's up to you to make the right decisions (or the one who mostly appease you) to calm her down and let her live this experience the best of ways.

However, as in real life, sometimes her stress level will increase regardless of what you do, because external happenings can always interfere with your "perfect life" together and you'll have to face unavoidable events which will test your bond with her.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/eaf19cc89b67c3d2fa3080d724490d2cf0971d93.jpg[/img]

While there's not enough in-game time to actually follow Elisa after her delivery, this will be definitely added in the game as a future content, but right now a full pregnancy experience is more than enough to deal with ;)

Another choice you might have made that will affect her pregnancy and stress is whether or not hiring a midwife (or more) into your staff at the clinic. Midwives have been a lovely, irreplaceable part of our own pregnancy experience and I wanted this to be present in my game as well. While they will work as a "hidden calculation" with just a couple dialogues, they can be quite useful in helping the parents-to-be to be as happy and relaxed as they can.

I sincerely hope you will enjoy Elisa's path.

Be safe and healthy,

notes.title: Rita's alternative path - Feedback DOES matter!
notes.notes:
Hello guys!

[b]In the past few weeks I received A LOT of feedback about Rita's story arc[/b], which involves a cuckold/Netorare path and was recently released. I was quite surprised by the amount of feedback about it, I admit, because polls told me Rita wasn't a top character for the fanbase, however as I always said [u][b]I completely rely on your feedback to improve the game[/b][/u] and make it fun and cool to play!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/cca63bc6d4d38b476b66e0bf7cdf8795076f7de1.jpg[/img]

[b]That's how I noticed her path/story wasn't very appreciated[/b], either because it wasn't fun or because no one wanted the Doctor to be a weak character who "lends" his girls around, and I'm now telling you: "I acknowledge your concerns!"

That's why [b]starting with 0.0.28[/b] (August update), together with Elisa's story which was already planned, I'll be adding a completely new path for Rita's story. [u][b]Whoever doesn't like/want a NTR path can completely avoid it[/b][/u], while Rita will demand other "tasks" to the doctor to appeal to her (she is quite demanding as a character). [b]The original path will still be available for those who'll enjoy it of course[/b], but it won't be the only path you can choose.

[u][b]I spent the last two years telling you that your feedback matters a lot, it would be silly to ignore it when it comes in such a massive way. And I sincerely THANK YOU for letting me know this wasn't working at all with the game.[/b][/u]

Be safe and healthy, always.

notes.title: Development Log #23: The Bank, The Garage, The Bonding Place
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow doctors!

In this very hot summer, at least in southern Europe, I thought about giving you some fresh news for you to enjoy!

Today I'm introducing you some new places to enjoy in the game, which will be delivered with update 0.0.27 which is about to be published for our Patreon supporters and in a few weeks for everyone as well!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/126d34dcd90e4f008209c601f71bba619bf630c2.png[/img]

All these places are tied to your relationship with Vanessa and Aaron, so you will only discover them by going through your relationship with them. Also, since they introduce new ways to get money and stats, they are also introduced quite late into the game to avoid breaking its balance.

The first place is [b]the Bank[/b] where Aaron works. You can go there to either talk with him (26 conversations have been added for both him and Vanessa, and they are not just the same ones repeating themselves, but are different lines who reflect the characters) or to use the bank services (i.e. [u]Loans[/u])

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/d9fb46de57e39fcdeb6b4c0a97c5bf950182a519.png[/img]

For a monthly fee you can get up to 100k $ to spend at the clinic, buying cars, paying staff members etc. You can only have the higher loans if your clinic has enough fame though, as the bank won't just give money to some unknown guy who needs it.

If you fail to repay the monthly fee you will lose A LOT of fame, so think about loans if you feel like paying them back!

The second place is [b]the Garage[/b], where Aaron or Vanessa (depending on who you chose on January to be your "Main Romantic Interest") will tweak cars for a price. And being you their partner you are offered a discount!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/2ee372aef0d5c036e4a5b043881bb8516d8cd013.png[/img]

If you own one or more cars/bykes, you can bring them there to be customized and earn some benefits.
[list]
[*] Adding ***ADS*** will cost you 4500$ and will boost your fame by 15 points each month.
[*] Modifying the ***ENGINE*** will cost you 10000$ and reduce the energy you need to move around to 0.
[*] Adding ***LED LIGHTS*** will cost you 3500$ and will boost your charm by 5 each month.
[*] You can do this for more than one vehicle, and the effects will stack.
[*] Each time you ask for a customization your relationship with Aaron/Vanessa will increase significantly.
[*] However, since they are self-learning mechanics, there is also a 3% chance they will damage your vehicle permanently.
[/list]

The final place is the [b]Bonding Place[/b], a place where you can play around with Aaron, Vanessa or both (yeah, threesomes!) and establish new bonds with them ;)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/8033d21f5d609e24a9d3f4a23d3928d1b02a3f9b.png[/img]

Unlocking a dozen new sex images and two brand new animations, you can go to the Bonding Place to earn some sexperience and progress your relationship with both Aaron and Vanessa, at least until they're satisfied of this kind of menage-a-trois.

Let me know what you think about this new additions, I can't do a good game without the players' support and feedback!

Be safe, healthy and be careful about the hot weather!

notes.title: Development Log #22: Approaching different relationships
notes.notes:
My [url=http://primadifesa.weebly.com/]ill-fated attempts to become a successful novelist [/url] (both the site and the book are in italian only, but I wouldn't call it a blockbuster success :D) showed me I was very interested in telling stories to an audience. That's something that brought me where I am today in fact: I just figured out that the best way to tell stories for me was developing videogames, and feedback seem to appreciate my way of storytelling.

General Practitioner has been praised many times for its conversations, its characters who are natural and different and each of them pursuing their own interest and agenda, without adapting to the player's choices. I mean, Aaron has his own view about gay relationships, as most gay people do, because no one is alike one another, and that's not something revolutionary in telling a story, but it's definitely something that is appreciated.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/3be4687b45091325fc0e9ded73b45ef2f588615d.png[/img]

While writing the stories for Vanessa and Aaron for 0.0.27 update I faced another challenge (this game posed me many of them): how to actually tell a story of homosexuality without sounding false and cliché, how to write an heterosexual storyline which intertwines with that one without sounding naive or offensive? And most important: do you need a gay writer to write gay stories? The answer is, in my case: no, you don't.

That's why I struggled for days to create something interesting in the game, something that would've been recognized as a real story for most homosexual players, something that I hope will entertain you and also make you smile a little. People who won't pursue a gay relationship in the game will still access this story, as it's part of the doctor's past where the player has no power upon, and helps to define the man he has become today.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/b2ab1b6d540d0ea32e229592dd866bb5613ed078.png[/img]

Are we just the sum of our past deeds and experiences? What would've been different if we acted differently 15/20 years ago? Are we sure everything would've worked better for us?

Yes, it is a bold endeavour and maybe those are stories that people clicking on the "Play" button of General Practitioner are not interested in reading. But somehow I believe that's not true, as most people loved the relationships in game more than they love the nudity in it, and since I started making videogames to tell stories and not mainly to show pixel-art nudity, believe me when I say I'm very happy to know my stories are appreciated and read by thousands of people.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/dd1b1a8353c135a0c01c29fb3c760276d3d0d45c.png[/img]

So maybe, just maybe, my attempts to become a novelist weren't so ill-fated eventually.

notes.title: Development Log #21: The need for clarity
notes.notes:
One of the most reported negative feedback about General Practitioner is its difficulty. Over time, I received reports of people who didn't enjoy the medical portion of the game (which is half the fun!) because of its inherent difficulty.

This is understandable and I always wanted to improve this aspect of the game without sacrificing its nature in doing it: General Practitioner is a Visual Novel unlike most others, as it involves a real medical simulation made with the help of real doctors and I never wanted players to just skip the medical part as it wasn't important for the game.

Of course, this makes GP sort of a "niche game", but so were the games from Legacy Games which I always took for inspiration for this project since its beginning.

In time, I added a setting "Medical Help" which, if the character has enough knowledge, gives hints about the findings. I recommend most players to play with the Medical Help ON, because some cases are very hard without it.

It was also suggested that every part of the game which is "normal" (in medicine nothing is "normal", it might be "unremarkable" at most), be labelled differently, so that people won't have to read through the same conversation and dialogues dozens of times.

With 0.0.27 every "normal" finding will have its text in blue and bold, so that you'll know those parts of dialogues mean the patient is ok with that part of his/her body. Of course now you will have to play an even closer attention to the black parts of the exam's text, because they will hint at real problems or will have remarks from the patients or other physicians present.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/8aa3464aa3f318175b7e0cd27f45ac02c9b7a6fc.png[/img]

I could've colored the "remarkable" parts in red, but I didn't do it for a variety of reasons, the first one being that remarkable parts are the most common  (because unlike real doctors you won't have to perform "healthy head to toe exams" at all in the game), and because part of General Practitioner's success is also its non-linear difficulty, facing the finding of something odd inside what has been quite normal until that very moment.

Starting with 0.0.27 I will also remove some very hard to read parts of the exam, because they weren't really adding something to the gameplay and were fun just to real doctors to read.

For example: [b]"ECG shows no ST-segment elevations in leads V1 and V2"[/b]
becomes: "There are no unusual synus patterns and no alterations in frequency of the hearbeat." which is far more readable.

Finally, we're going to introduce a new option to show the clinic's daily results or not when going through mornings and evenings.

I hope you'll like the new additions to the game, we're approaching Beta in six months and everything will need to be polished by then! Wish me a good luck! :D
